assessments.reasoning: SAP places declaration of the variable at compilation, including when control never reaches the statement. The operand must occupy a compatible writing position and its type must be fully derivable statically. The claim concerns declaration timing only.

challenge.method: Check unreachable code and the same DATA(var) spelling in a context with an existing data object named data.
challenge.results: An unreachable valid declaration still declares the variable. With the existing object named data, SAP interprets the spelling as substring access, so the declaration rule has no application.

limitations: The documented form needs a compatible writing declaration position. An existing data object named data changes the interpretation of DATA(var) to substring access.
